messages:
lina_ops: Quick heads-up — TPU-S4 reserved pools are live in sa-east1 (Sao Paulo) as of now. This is an initial availability rollout (preview) with constrained capacity. Please read the notes below before routing traffic. :tada:

matt_infra: Nice! Are these preemptible or dedicated-reserved VMs? Any eviction behavior we should be aware of?

lina_ops: Non-preemptible reserved nodes. We’re exposing a 'burst' pool with soft limits (see quota notes). Eviction only for hardware failures; no scheduled preemption.

lina_ops: Quick config snippet customers can use to pin to the new pool:
```
route: 
  region: sa-east1
  capacity_tier: reserved-tpu-s4
  fallback: us-east1
  model_family: tpu-s4-v1
```

anya_sales: Tagging AE team — we'll need suggested messaging for customers on latency improvements + recommended use-cases. Also want an ETA for public pricing. @finance-bot? :eyes: 

finance-bot: Provisional pricing sheet uploaded to the pricing drive. Final publish scheduled tomorrow at 10:00 PT. Will post the public doc and marketplace SKU after that.

tom_sre: Can we get a per-tenant alert for sustained queue growth in sa-east1? We should warn customers before we breach latency SLOs.

lina_ops: Good call — enabled a watch rule and an alert channel (ops/tpu-s4-sa). Short-term thresholds: queue_length > 50 for 2m triggers an alert. We'll tune after a day.

matt_infra: Any special kernel/kubectl flags required for the new nodes? I can push node image update if needed.

lina_ops: No special flags; image v2026.03 includes TPU-S4 drivers and kernel optimizations. Rolling deploy schedule attached in the internal runbook.

deploy-bot: Rollout ticket created: RB-5123 — includes health checks, dashboard links, and rollback steps.

capacitybot: Pool capacity initial allocation: 120 reserved units (customers may see capacity warnings if committing >80 units). Burst pool cap: 40% of region allocation.

anya_sales: Thanks — will prep AE notes and a short FAQ. Can we get a short bullet list of recommended model families to try on TPU-S4?

lina_ops: Recommended: medium-length chat models and encoder-decoder families for fast throughput. Avoid heavy attention-long-context models until we validate KV cache behavior for >8k contexts.

matt_infra: I'll coordinate on the node image roll and verify perf tests this afternoon.

anya_sales: Great — I'll wait for the finalized pricing doc then push to the customer comms channel. :+1:

lina_ops: Thanks everyone. If you hit any regression, tag @lina_ops and include trace IDs. We'll protect the pool with automatic fallback to us-east1 for the first 48h.

tom_sre: Copy — monitoring + runbook review today.

lina_ops: Closing the announcement — internal docs: https://console.redwood.ai/internal/tpu-s4-sa-readme and reserved pool runbook: https://console.redwood.ai/runbooks/rb-5123
